name: Noisebox
author: Wyatt
description: Synthesised background noise — rain, ocean, wind, stream, fan and plain white/pink/brown — generated live from shaped noise, with sliders to dial each one in. No sample files.

barWidget.description: Toggle and shape a synthesised ambience: rain, surf, wind, a stream, a fan, or plain coloured noise.

schema.label: Show sound name
schema.description: Print the active sound next to the icon. Off keeps it an icon-only pill.

schema.label: Show sleep countdown
schema.description: While a sleep timer is armed, show the minutes left in the bar.
